title: settings: worktrees
description: Worktree lifecycle settings (DW01), owned by the project component.

root.description: Directory under which new worktrees are created. Absolute, or relative to the main worktree's parent.

branch-prefix.description: Prefix for task branches; {owner} expands to the owning account.

protected.description: Named worktrees that list marks protected and finish/prune never touch: name to absolute path (for example the shared runtime install).

checks.description: Pre-push checks, by id: id to a fixed command (argv list, no shell). Honoured ONLY from your user settings: a project file that defines or changes these is refused, because it is repository-controlled code. {tip}, {base} and {worktree} in an argument are replaced by the tool.

pre-push.description: Ids of the checks that must pass before `worktree push` publishes. Safe in project settings: it names checks, each user maps to a command in worktrees.checks.
